messages:
maria: perf-bot just flagged a nightly regression on the small-batch suite for rwd/opt-7b-quant — p99 went up ~45% vs yesterday. artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/example/1842506789 :eyes:
perf-bot: [automatic] nightly-perf-run detected increased latency: suite=small-batch, metric=p99, delta=+45%, baseline=2026-03-16T02:00Z, run=2026-03-17T02:00Z
aj: ack — on it. tagging @kim for profiling help. any quick smoke?
kim: can someone grab the perf-profile and the kernel logs? I want the full trace. if it's KV-cache related we should see a spike in cache-miss counters.
maria: uploading two artifacts now: - perf flame (flamegraph.svg) - bench logs (bench.log.gz) - brief tail of runner: ```
[2026-03-17T02:03:12Z] run start commit=abc123
[2026-03-17T02:04:50Z] p99=420ms p50=32ms
[2026-03-17T02:04:51Z] p99=610ms p50=33ms
```
noah: quick hypothesis: a GPU kernel update landed on staging last night. maybe kernel selection fell back to slower path for certain sequence lengths.
aj: good call. @ci-bot which infra image did the nightly use?
ci-bot: nightly-run 1842506789 used image rwd-infer:2026-03-16-kernels-v2.2, env=staging, nodes=8-gpu-a100
kim: if it's kernel-v2.2 that's the suspect. can we re-run the same bench pinned to v2.1 to confirm?
maria: @sre-oncall can you spin up a 1-node repro with v2.1 and v2.2 side-by-side? small-batch config: --batch-size=4 --seq=1024 --prefill=64
sre-oncall: on it. provisioning now, will post IPs & logs. ETA ~12m.
aj: meanwhile I'll start a quick bisection on the model-serving commit range between abc120..abc123 and validate config. if it's infra-only we'll know fast.
perf-bot: rerun suggestion: please run `./tools/run_bench --suite small-batch --commit abc123 --image rwd-infer:2026-03-16-kernels-v2.1 --repeat 5` and attach results.
noah: if re-run confirms v2.1 is fine and v2.2 regresses, we should pin deploy and open kernel revert PR. also check quantization path differences.
kim: also check paged KV cache statistics: in bench.log.gz grep for KV_CACHE_MISS or similar. I saw a pattern in prior incidents.
maria: thanks. I'll summarize in the incident doc once we have repro: https://docs.internal.redwood/incidents/infra/1842506789
aj: pinging infra-eng for kernel rollout notes. @infra-eng any known perf diffs with v2.2?
(no response yet)
sre-oncall: repro nodes are up: 10.0.12.34 (v2.1) and 10.0.12.35 (v2.2). I've copied bench command to /home/ci/run.sh. Logs will stream to /var/log/nightly/1842506789/.
kim: running flame compare now, will post a short writeup. if I don't find anything in 10m I'll start sampling cuda profiler.
maria: appreciated. also adding a canary rollback plan to the doc in case it's infra. :thumbsup:
aj: thanks all, please drop short updates here only. if we need paging i'll escalate.
(noise) perf-bot: note: recent PR #7892 touched kernel selection heuristics — related? link: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/7892
noah: that PR is in model-serving not infra, but it changes sequence-length thresholds. could interact badly with new kernel defaults. add to checklist.
kim: quick update: initial flamegraphs show heavier time in matmul kernel for 1024 seq on v2.2 — not KV cache. pushing svg to artifacts.
maria: that's critical. if it's matmul kernel, infra rollback won't fix it; we need kernel tuning or revert PR7892.
aj: I'll pause the canary. @product if this affects SLAs i'll flag. (not in thread)
kim: final for now: samples indicate regression reproducible on v2.2, open issue created: https://issues.internal.redwood/infra/PI-184250 — assigned to gpu-kernel-team.
maria: closing loop: action items: 1) AJ - hold canary and gather bisect 2) SRE - keep repro & logs 3) KIM - kernel profiling writeup 4) NOAH - coordinate with kernel team 5) MARIA - incident doc & next steps. will update when kernel-team responds. :white_check_mark:
